name: boundhound
description: Autonomous pentest agent with enforced, deny-by-default scope safety. Phase 8: recon + enumeration + bounded exploitation + verified findings + reporting, orchestrated end to end by /fullscan through the enforced bh-exec choke point (resumable with --resume, bounded retry, and step budgets), plus a second deny-by-default choke point for Burp Suite MCP calls — which run host-side and bypass bh-exec — with a bh-burp-scope mirror into Burp's own Target Scope. Ships an 81-skill self-authored technique-playbook library wired to the bounded tools and safety model.
